 Hayley Williams announces venues & ticketing details for 2027 Asia tour in Singapore, Manila, Seoul & Tokyo
 SPINS 
 2K 
 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 Photography by Zachary Gray 
 First published: 17 November 2026 
 Last updated: 17 November 2026 
 News 
 Gigs 
 Events 
 Hayley Williams is bringing her solo catalogue to The Star Theatre this February, with ticketing details now confirmed for her Singapore show.
 Following the announcement of her Asia tour , the Paramore frontwoman will perform in Singapore on 26 February as part of The Hayley Williams Show . Presented by AEG Presents Asia , the concert joins stops in Manila, Seoul, and Tokyo on her 2027 itinerary. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by AEG Presents Asia (@aegpresentsasia) 
 The 2027 Asian run begins at Manila’s Araneta Coliseum on 24 February , before heading to Singapore, Seoul’s Yes24 Live Hall on 1 March, and Tokyo’s Toyosu PIT on 3 March . Click here for ticketing details.
 In Singapore, fans hoping to secure tickets early can access the fan club presale from 18 November, 12 PM, until 19 November, 11:59 PM. Further details are available through the official fan sign-up page , with general sales beginning on 20 November, 12 PM, via AXS .
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by AEG Presents Asia (@aegpresentsasia) 
 The upcoming shows will feature material across Williams’ three solo albums, Petals for Armor , FLOWERS for VASES / descansos , and Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party , alongside some surprises. While her earlier tour saw her perform her latest album in full each night, this run opens up the setlist to the wider world of her solo work.
